title: Scriptura Verification Check Result
description: The result of one verification check over a claim and its evidence chain. Normative source: BKB-VERIFY-001 section 7. A check that cannot decide must report uncheckable; it must not guess and must not silently pass.

passed.description: A false result is not a deletion. Refuted claims are retained.

uncheckable.description: What could not be checked, and why. Mandatory in substance where the check could not decide.
